prompt_en: A quiet cinematic fashion editorial at blue hour after rain inside an art deco tram depot preparing a heritage exhibition. A clearly adult woman, around twenty-nine, brings a framed route-map print upright on a padded waist-high worktable. Her left hand grips its upper corner, her right hand holds the lower side, and its bottom edge remains on the padded table as its top becomes horizontal. The frame and table stand beside her legs. Both feet rest flat on the dry floor, knees softly extended, torso slightly turned toward the table, face toward the camera. Use the supplied portrait as guidance for visible face and hair appearance: a short dark bob, fine separated fringe, softly rounded facial contours and readable dark eyes. Her calm focused expression belongs to this working moment. Her pale ivory collared blouse is fully buttoned and tucked into a warm charcoal tailored mini skirt, whose continuous exterior hem makes the short skirt silhouette readable. Black sheer thigh-high hosiery wraps both legs, ending above their knees. On each leg, a short outer garment hem ends above the adult leg's above-knee hosiery boundary; a visible band of thigh skin lies between those two garment edges on the same leg; both textile edges remain identifiable beside the continuous uncovered skin band. In the black textile, the adult leg's skin tone remains visible through a continuous hosiery layer; a readable hosiery boundary or fabric texture identifies the layer on that same leg; the hosiery surface follows the connected knee calf and ankle without replacing their anatomy. Under shared cool skylight and an amber work lamp, directional highlights follow the adult leg's curved hosiery surface; visible fabric evidence locates those highlights on hosiery rather than bare skin; the same continuous leg contour remains readable beside the highlight bands. Simple dark low-heeled shoes ground her stance. Use a front three-quarter full-body view with her head, face, hands, skirt hem, skin bands, knees and both shoes clearly readable. A tram and arched windows recede behind her; damp reflections sit outside the doorway.
